# Claims Assessment Memo

**Insured:** Alder Mews Architects | **Policy:** CC-1518 | **Incident reference:** IR/2026/4182

## 1. Summary

Alder Mews Architects reported on 25 June 2026 the accidental drop of a tablet and a drawing display during transport, in a hotel meeting room in Leeds. The claim is for the two items, invoiced at 2,018 dollars and 1,624 dollars. I recommend the claim is covered under clause 4.5 (Transit). The reserve is 3,642 dollars, with no excess applied because none is shown in the file.

## 2. Facts

- The insured is Alder Mews Architects, under policy CC-1518. [notice of loss]
- The loss was reported on 25 June 2026. [notice of loss]
- The reported loss is an accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display. [notice of loss]
- The location is a hotel meeting room in Leeds. [notice of loss] [incident report]
- The incident report (reference IR/2026/4182) is dated 27 June 2026 and was made by Alder Mews Architects. [incident report]
- The items are a tablet and a drawing display. [incident report]
- The circumstances are an accidental drop during transport. No third party was involved. [incident report]
- The tablet was supplied by Beacon Office Supply at 2,018 dollars. [invoice 1]
- The drawing display was supplied by Crane & Sons Electronics at 1,624 dollars. [invoice 2]
- The file does not contain the policy schedule, the date of the drop, or a description of the damage. The file also does not state who was carrying the items or between which premises. [notice of loss] [incident report]

## 3. Coverage analysis

**Operative clause.** Clause 4.5 covers "accidental loss of or damage to portable equipment while being carried by an employee between premises." [policy cl. 4.5] Both the notice of loss and the incident report describe an accidental drop of a tablet and a drawing display during transport. [notice of loss] [incident report] This fits clause 4.5. The file does not expressly say that an employee was carrying the items between premises, so this should be confirmed with the insured before payment.

**Other cover clauses considered.**
- Clause 4.2 (Contents) responds only to theft, fire, storm or escape of water. [policy cl. 4.2] None is reported, so it does not apply.
- Clause 4.7 (Escape of water) requires water escaping from a fixed pipe, tank or appliance. [policy cl. 4.7] No water is reported, so it does not apply.
- Clause 4.9 (Electrical surge) requires a surge in the electrical supply. [policy cl. 4.9] No surge is reported, so it does not apply.

**Exclusions considered.**
- Clause 7.1 (Unattended property) excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space. [policy cl. 7.1] No theft is reported and the loss is recorded as a drop during transport. [notice of loss] [incident report] The exclusion does not apply.
- Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear) excludes gradual deterioration. [policy cl. 7.3] The loss is recorded as a single accidental drop, not gradual deterioration. [incident report] The exclusion does not apply.
- Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss) excludes a loss not reported to the police within seven days where theft is alleged. [policy cl. 7.5] Theft is not alleged. [notice of loss] [incident report] The exclusion does not apply, and no police report is required.

## 4. Decision

**Covered**, under clause 4.5 (Transit). [policy cl. 4.5] This is subject to confirming that an employee was carrying the items between premises. No exclusion in clause 7 applies. [policy cl. 7.1, 7.3, 7.5]

## 5. Reserve

| Item | Amount (dollars) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Tablet | 2,018 | [invoice 1] |
| Drawing display | 1,624 | [invoice 2] |
| **Sum of invoices** | **3,642** | |
| Excess | none shown | [policy cl. 9.1] |

Clause 9.1 sets the reserve as the sum of the invoices, less the 250 dollar excess only where the policy schedule applies one. [policy cl. 9.1] The schedule is not in the file, so no excess is shown and none is applied.

**Reserve: 3,642 dollars.** If the schedule is later found to apply the 250 dollar excess, the reserve would reduce to 3,392 dollars.
